heading: Your project data stays on hardware we own.
paragraphs: Point clouds, imagery, and project documents are processed on Axiom-owned GPU workstations in a controlled, on-premise environment. We don't upload client data to third-party AI services.

Where AI helps — reviewing specifications and submittals, drafting deviation reports, organizing contract documents — it runs on open-weight models hosted on our own hardware. A licensed surveyor reviews every deliverable.
Storage, retention, transfer, and destruction terms are set per engagement to match your contract's data-handling requirements.
